description_en: Clears all follows of a specific object type for a digital employee
description_zh: 清空数字员工精确对象类型全部关注
name: ClearOperatingObjectFavorites

parameters.help_en: The tenant ID to take effect
parameters.name: tenant_id

parameters.help_en: The graph name. You can call listGraphs to obtain the value
parameters.help_zh: 图谱名称，可先调用 listGraphs 获取
parameters.name: graph_name

parameters.help_en: The operating object name, such as customer_1
parameters.name: operating_object_name

parameters.help_en: The object type, such as customer. This parameter has a value when type is set to mention
parameters.help_zh: 对象类型如 customer，type=mention 时有值
parameters.name: object_type

200.description_en: 清空精确范围全部持久化关注并复核物理剩余量
200.description_zh: 清空精确范围全部持久化关注并复核物理剩余量

code.description_en: The status code. SUCCESS indicates success. In case of failure, the corresponding error type is returned, such as ERR_BAD_REQUEST, ERR_VALIDATION_FAILED, or ERR_INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR
code.description_zh: SUCCESS 为成功，失败情况返回对应错误类型，比如 ERR_BAD_REQUEST ERR_VALIDATION_FAILED ERR_INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR

graphName.description_en: The graph name. You can call listGraphs to obtain the value
graphName.description_zh: 图谱名称，可先调用 listGraphs 获取

objectType.description_en: The object type, such as customer. This parameter has a value when type is set to mention
objectType.description_zh: 对象类型如 customer，type=mention 时有值

operatingObjectName.description_en: The digital employee name (operating object name, optional)
operatingObjectName.description_zh: 数字员工名称（运营对象 name，可选）

remainingCount.description_en: The number of remaining followed objects within the specified scope
remainingCount.description_zh: 精确范围内剩余关注对象数量

removedCount.description_en: The number of physical follow records that were actually deleted
removedCount.description_zh: 实际删除的物理关注记录数量

verified.description_en: Indicates whether the remaining record count has been verified as zero within the same transaction
verified.description_zh: 是否已在同一事务内复核剩余记录为零
